digestContract.canonicalization: Build an object mapping each source field in fields to its exact current original string. Sort field names by Unicode code point; serialize as compact JSON with no ASCII escaping, whitespace, normalization or trailing newline; hash the UTF-8 bytes. Field names are ASCII in this edition, so JS lexicographic sorting is equivalent.
digestContract.coverage: Only the original display fields listed in fields. Versions, stable IDs, selectors, native digests and stateGuards must also match independently. This is a translation-source digest, never a replacement for a machine/identity digest.
digestContract.mismatch: Do not use this translation group. Render the current permitted original text with an explicit source-changed/unavailable indicator; never restore a withdrawn or inaccessible source from this public dictionary.
digestContract.missingVersion: A null version means the original has no content version; compare the field digest and source identity rather than inventing a version.
